buildPrompt.excerpt:
DealSaathi — Complete AI-Powered Real Estate Assistant Using ViaSocket Skill
Objective
Build DealSaathi, an AI-powered real estate assistant for brokers and property managers. The application should allow users to describe tasks in natural language and have the AI understand their requests, collect missing information, select the appropriate supported ViaSocket action, request confirmation where necessary, and execute real operations through connected applications.
The application will support five primary workflows:

1. Property Lead Management.
2. Automated Lead Follow-ups.
3. Property Viewing Scheduling.
4. Property Matching.
5. Rent Payment Reminders.

The primary goal is to create a functional, polished demonstration of an AI agent that performs real operations through ViaSocket rather than merely displaying a chatbot interface.
Important project constraints:

* Build and test the application locally on my computer.
* Do not push to GitHub.
* Do not create commits or pull requests.
* Do not deploy to Embarko or any other hosting platform.
* Use the selected repository and preserve unrelated work.
* Follow the official ViaSocket Skill and do not invent undocumented APIs.
* I am not an experienced developer, so explain blockers and required manual steps in simple language.

lines: Deploy this app to Embarko — cloud hosting for small apps. No Dockerfile, no signup.
Read https://embarko.ai/docs/quickstart.md and follow it. Nothing to install.

Deploy it under my account, not anonymously: use DEPLOY_TOKEN or ~/.embarko/credentials if either is already set, and if neither is, ask me for one — I can create it on the "Deploy tokens" page at https://embarko.ai/app/tokens — and save it to ~/.embarko/credentials so later deploys reuse it.
This matters — an anonymous deploy isn't attached to my account, so it won't show up in my Embarko console and is deleted after 24 hours.
Faster, if your tools let you install one: npx skills add embarko-ai/skill --skill embarko-deploy -g
